gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-phoenicia: Azonix draws every stroke with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, wide-mouthed and commanding, with capitals barely above the lowercase. Noto Sans Phoenician follows with generous height and sweeping s curves.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Approachable is the first impression of Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi, with gaping e mouths and capitals that barely rise. Azonix sits above it with one stroke width across the whole alphabet, so paragraphs below it would feel easygoing.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Round and porthole-wide, Noto Sans Rejang opens its lowercase counters like glass windows. And Azonix, with its flat, unmodulated line, can be sized up for headings while the body stays modest.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads big and compact, with a tall x-height, tight ascender room and curves that never close. Azonix is built from rounded rods of one weight, best for commanding headings, while Noto Sans Runic handles the running text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Azonix lays down a stroke with no thin parts and no swell, commanding and wide-mouthed. And Noto Sans Samaritan gives it a hefty, approachable lowercase with plenty of daylight inside its curves.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-saurashtr: Wide, flat and unswelling, Azonix turns its corners without any pressure bulge. And Noto Sans Saurashtra sits underneath with counters that stay connected to the outside, so the two feel clean and uncluttered.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-sc: Azonix has a soft, featureless hum to its lines, with capitals only slightly above lowercase and wide-mouthed letters. Noto Sans SC stays modest, so give it a smaller size.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada is bulky in the lowercase, with open c forms. Under Azonix, whose unit-width stroke feels steady and commanding, paragraphs would read with a clean, approachable rhythm.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Big middle, loose s. Noto Sans Siddham has a large central band in its line. And if Azonix gets made small, its bowls with no thinning at the sides stay crisp, though the body would feel big.
